definitions.gloss: stones placed at the bottom of a flowerpot for drainage
definitions.explanation: Lightweight stones or gravel laid in the bottom of a flowerpot before the soil is added. They improve drainage and air flow at the base, helping prevent root rot from waterlogging.

examples.japanese: {鉢底石|はちぞこいし}を{敷|し}く。
examples.english: Lay drainage stones at the bottom.

examples.japanese: {土|つち}を{入|い}れる{前|まえ}に{鉢底石|はちぞこいし}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Put in drainage stones before adding the soil.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}はけをよくするために{鉢底石|はちぞこいし}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: Use drainage stones to improve drainage.

notes:
Compound of {鉢底|はちぞこ} (pot bottom) + {石|いし} (stone).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉢底石|はちぞこいし}を{敷|し}く: to lay drainage stones
- {水|みず}はけをよくする: to improve drainage

RELATED:
- {軽石|かるいし}: pumice — a common material for drainage stones
- {培養土|ばいようど}: potting soil, added on top of the stones
